payload.sql: SELECT scb.scb_name, u.ward_name, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_scb_area_urban_private u ON scb.id = u.scb_id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 3 AND scb.state_name ILIKE '%TAMIL NADU%' AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: Show organization address for other members in Punjab
payload.sql: SELECT scb.scb_name, om.org_name, om.address, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_scb_other_members_private om ON scb.id = om.state_cooperative_bank_id WHERE scb.state_name ILIKE '%PUNJAB%' AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: Total turnover for StCB banks implementing state schemes
payload.sql: SELECT SUM(scb.annual_turnover) FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_scb_schemes_private s ON scb.id = s.state_cooperative_bank_id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 1 AND s.scheme_type = 2 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: Which banks are implementing Central Government schemes?
payload.sql: SELECT scb.scb_name, s.govt_scheme_name, s.total_amount_extended, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_scb_schemes_private s ON scb.id = s.state_cooperative_bank_id WHERE s.scheme_type = 1 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: Total net profit of DCCBs grouped by state
payload.sql: SELECT scb.state_name, SUM(scb.net_profit) FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 2 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0 GROUP BY scb.state_name;

payload.question: List all members for DCCBs with turnover > 100 Lakhs
payload.sql: SELECT dm.name, om.org_name, scb.annual_turnover, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_dccb_master_private dm ON scb.id = dm.id JOIN chatbot_scb_other_members_private om ON scb.id = om.state_cooperative_bank_id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 2 AND scb.annual_turnover > 100 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: Number of PCARDBs operating in each rural block of Haryana
payload.sql: SELECT r.block_name, COUNT(DISTINCT scb.id) FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_scb_area_rural_private r ON scb.id = r.scb_id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 4 AND scb.state_name ILIKE '%HARYANA%' AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0 GROUP BY r.block_name;

payload.question: Show block names covered by SCARDB in Madhya Pradesh
payload.sql: SELECT scb.scb_name, r.block_name, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_scb_area_rural_private r ON scb.id = r.scb_id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 3 AND scb.state_name ILIKE '%MADHYA PRADESH%' AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: Which banks have active audit reports and contact info?
payload.sql: SELECT scb.scb_name, scb.latest_audit_year, scd.contact_person, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_scb_contact_details scd ON scb.id = scd.state_cooperative_bank_id WHERE scb.latest_audit_year IS NOT NULL AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: Find phone numbers for PCARDB banks in Rajasthan
payload.sql: SELECT scb.scb_name, scd.phone_number, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_scb_contact_details scd ON scb.id = scd.state_cooperative_bank_id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 4 AND scb.state_name ILIKE '%RAJASTHAN%' AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: Which DCCBs in MAHARASHTRA are functional?
payload.sql: SELECT dm.name, scb.district_name, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_dccb_master_private dm ON scb.id = dm.id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 2 AND scb.state_name ILIKE '%MAHARASHTRA%' AND scb.functional_status = 1 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: Show banks operating in Mumbai
payload.sql: SELECT scb.scb_name, scb.full_address, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb WHERE (scb.full_address LIKE '%Mumbai%' OR scb.city_name = 'Mumbai') AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: List all SCBs and their corresponding offices buildings
payload.sql: SELECT scb.scb_name, scb.office_building_type_name, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 1 AND scb.has_office_building = 1 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: List urban area of operation wards for PCARDB banks
payload.sql: SELECT scb.scb_name, u.ward_name, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_scb_area_urban_private u ON scb.id = u.scb_id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 4 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: Fetch member pincode for DCCB affiliates
payload.sql: SELECT dm.name, m.organization_name, m.pincode, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_dccb_master_private dm ON scb.id = dm.id JOIN chatbot_scb_members_private m ON scb.id = m.state_cooperative_bank_id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 2 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: Show scheme implementation for DCCBs in Telangana
payload.sql: SELECT dm.name, s.govt_scheme_name, s.total_amount_extended, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_dccb_master_private dm ON scb.id = dm.id JOIN chatbot_scb_schemes_private s ON scb.id = s.state_cooperative_bank_id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 2 AND scb.state_name ILIKE '%TELANGANA%' AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: Find SCBs that implemented State Government schemes
payload.sql: SELECT scb.scb_name, s.govt_scheme_name, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_scb_schemes_private s ON scb.id = s.state_cooperative_bank_id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 1 AND s.scheme_type = 2 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: Count of active SCARDB branches in each district of Assam
payload.sql: SELECT scb.district_name, SUM(cast(scb.number_of_branches as integer)) FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 3 AND scb.state_name ILIKE '%ASSAM%' AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0 GROUP BY scb.district_name;

payload.question: List StCBs that are reporting a net loss greater than 0
payload.sql: SELECT scb.scb_name, scb.state_name, scb.net_loss, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 1 AND scb.is_profit_making = '0' AND cast(scb.net_loss as float) > 0 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

payload.question: Count of SCARDBs per Urban body in Tamil Nadu
payload.sql: SELECT scb.urban_local_body_name, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 3 AND scb.state_name ILIKE '%TAMIL NADU%' AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0 GROUP BY scb.urban_local_body_name;
